newsitem.title: EGYPT: Lonely Egypt widow digs ups dead husband's skull.
newsitem.headline: Lonely Egypt widow digs ups dead husband's skull.

text.p: Egyptian police arrested a widow who had dug up her dead husband's skull because she was lonely and missed his company, Al-Ahram daily said on Thursday.

The state-owned newspaper said the 48-year-old woman told police that her husband, who died four years ago, had asked her in a dream to take him back to their home in Menofiya province because he wanted to be with her.
She then sifted through his grave and found that only his skull remained. Police caught the woman carrying the skull out of the cemetery and charged her with desecrating a grave.
